name: Artificer's Orb
description: Adds an Augment Socket to a Martial Weapon, wand, staff or Armour
directions: Right click this item then left click a Martial Weapon, wand, staff or Armour to apply it.
consoleDirections: X to use, then A on an armour, wand, staff or martial weapon to apply it.
keywordDefinition: Adds an Augment Socket to a Martial Weapon or Armour
